name: B6·1 AI Voice & Speech Suite — Kannada call agent + call→CRM + voice-note→CRM (3 automations combined)

parameters.content:
## ⚙️ SETUP — step by step (paid APIs involved)
**A. Voice agent (Vapi.ai — ~$0.05-0.10/min):**
1. vapi.ai → create account → Assistants → New: model GPT-4o-mini/Gemini, voice: an Indian-English or Kannada voice (Vapi supports 11labs/Azure voices — pick `kn-IN` Azure voice for Kannada), transcriber: Deepgram multi.
2. System prompt (paste): 'You are the friendly receptionist of {BRAND}, a gold jewellery showroom in Mysore. Answer store hours, address, today's gold rate {RATE}, and BOOK APPOINTMENTS by collecting name, phone, preferred day/time. Speak Kannada if the caller speaks Kannada. Keep answers under 3 sentences.'
3. Phone: buy/port a number in Vapi (or connect Twilio/Exotel SIP) → assign the assistant.
4. Assistant → Server URL → paste this workflow's `vapi-events` Production URL. Vapi now POSTs call events + transcripts here.

**B. Voice notes → CRM:** owner/staff forward any customer voice note to the Telegram bot → auto-transcribed (Gemini) → structured into the CRM.

## HOW IT RUNS
• Call ends → summary + extracted booking → CRM sheet + Telegram alert (+ calendar-ready details).
• Voice note to bot → Gemini transcribes + extracts {name, phone, interest, follow-up} → Enquiries tab.

## 🔧 FIX
• No events → Server URL not saved on the ASSISTANT (not org level).
• Wrong language voice → change voice in Vapi, not here.
• Booking fields empty → tighten the assistant prompt ('always confirm name & phone digit by digit').
